versions.content: If the DET is en abled and the status of the CORE Test module is CORTST_RUNNING_BGND , the function CortTst_DeInit shall report the error value CORTST_E_STATUS_FAILURE to the DET, and then immediately return.

If the DET is enabled and the status of the CORE Test module is CORTST_RUNNING_BGND , the function CortTst_DeInit shall report the error value CORTST_E_STATUS_FAILURE to the DET, and then immediately return.
